project.name: EWS Persistence Core
project.description:
Shared JPA entities and Spring Data repositories for the canonical tables in db/migration/V1__init_phase1_baseline.sql that multiple services both read and write: canonical_event_envelope, feature_value, and signal_instance (with its evidence/risk-intent/ risk-dimension/disposition-tag child tables). Exists to avoid duplicating entity definitions across ews-feature-processor (writes feature_value), ews-signal-policy-engine (writes signal_instance), ews-case-workflow-service (updates signal_instance status) and ews-experience-api (reads signal_instance + feature_value for evidence drill-down).
Entities are hand-written rather than generated from the JSON Schema contracts under schemas/, because jsonschema2pojo (used by ews-schemas) produces plain POJOs, not JPA-annotated entities; field names and allowed enum values are kept in sync with the schemas by convention and checked indirectly by ews-event-contracts-test parsing the same source contracts.
